# featbit_feature_flag (Resource)

Manages a FeatBit Feature Flag definition through the documented public API.

Terraform owns the flag definition shown in the schema. Only `name` updates in
place. The Environment, key, variation type, description, and ordered
variations define replacement. Variation values are strings and are validated
and compared according to `boolean`, `string`, `number`, or `json` semantics.

Targeting, rules, percentage rollouts, enabled state, and tags remain owned by
the FeatBit UI and are not read into or rewritten by this resource. Use the UI
or another purpose-built workflow for those operational settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "featbit_project" "example" {
  name = "Checkout service"
  key  = "checkout-service"
}

resource "featbit_environment" "example" {
  project_id = featbit_project.example.id
  name       = "Staging"
  key        = "staging"
}

resource "featbit_feature_flag" "example" {
  environment_id = featbit_environment.example.id
  name           = "New checkout"
  key            = "new-checkout"
  description    = "Selects the checkout implementation"
  variation_type = "boolean"

  variations = [
    {
      name  = "Enabled"
      value = "true"
    },
    {
      name  = "Disabled"
      value = "false"
    },
  ]
}
```

The Environment ID reference orders Project, Environment, and Feature Flag
creation and reverses that order during destroy.

## Lifecycle

- `name` updates in place.
- `environment_id`, `key`, `description`, `variation_type`, and semantic
  `variations` changes require replacement.
- The key is exact and case-sensitive within one Environment. Create refuses
  active or archived exact-key collisions instead of adopting them.
- Destroy archives the flag, permanently deletes it, and removes state only
  after complete active and archived views prove exact absence.
- If a managed flag is archived outside Terraform, refresh preserves state and
  asks you to restore it or continue through the destroy path.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Immutable parent Environment UUID.
- `key` (String) Immutable exact Feature Flag key within the parent Environment.
- `name` (String) Feature Flag display name. This is the only field updated in place.
- `variation_type` (String) Immutable variation type: boolean, string, number, or json.
- `variations` (Attributes List) Immutable ordered Feature Flag variations. IDs are computed deterministically for provider-created flags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variations))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Immutable Feature Flag description. An omitted value canonicalizes to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Feature Flag UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--variations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variations`

Required:

- `name` (String) Variation display name.
- `value` (String) Variation value, canonicalized according to variation_type.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Stable variation UUID.

## Import

Import a Feature Flag with its Environment UUID and exact case-sensitive key:

```shell
terraform import featbit_feature_flag.example '<environment_uuid>/<exact_key>'
```

The UUID uses 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal form. The key contains 1 through 128 ASCII
letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.
